title: Fix crash when uploading avatar larger than 5MB
body: Steps to reproduce: upload a >5MB PNG in profile settings. App throws an unhandled exception and the settings page goes blank. Expected: a friendly validation error instead.

title: Add dark mode toggle to settings page
body: Users have asked for a dark mode option. Add a toggle in Settings > Appearance that switches the app theme and persists the choice per user.

title: Revamp onboarding flow for new users
body: The current onboarding is a single long form. We want to break this into a multi-step wizard: account basics, team invite, first project setup, and a guided tour. This touches signup, the dashboard empty state, and email notifications.

title: Search results paginate incorrectly on page 2+
body: Clicking 'next page' on search results shows duplicate items from page 1 instead of new results. Looks like the offset param isn't being applied server-side.

title: Add CSV export for billing history
body: Finance team wants to download billing history as CSV from the billing page, including invoice date, amount, and status.

title: Typo in password reset email subject line
body: Subject reads 'Reset Yor Password' — should be 'Reset Your Password'.

title: Build notifications center (in-app + email digest)
body: We need a unified notifications system: an in-app notification bell with unread counts, a notifications feed page, per-category preferences, and a daily email digest. Likely needs a new data model, background job for digests, and new UI components.

title: API returns 500 when filtering by empty tag list
body: GET /api/items?tags= returns a 500 instead of an empty result set or a 400. Should validate the query param.

title: Add keyboard shortcut for quick search (Cmd+K)
body: Add a global Cmd+K / Ctrl+K shortcut that opens a quick search modal, similar to Linear/GitHub.

title: Memory leak in dashboard websocket connection
body: Leaving the dashboard open for a few hours causes memory usage to climb steadily. Suspect the websocket reconnect logic isn't cleaning up old listeners.
